name: em-steps-v1
about: end-morph step A (fix-end-morph, lead GO 2026-10-05): toolbar steps in the end zone, Simulator, counts only. No reload: the page is placed by em-step-sim.mjs before the run (closed rest above the zone, or open at the end). Pairs of slow strokes: finger down (the page scrolls up, Safari's toolbar shows) then finger up (the page scrolls down, the toolbar hides), each followed by a pause so the 7d settle has ended before the next stroke.
